race.description: Corporate Membership At Bunbury Turf Club Hcp (C5)
race.comment: Lots of win chances. YAMASHITA'S GOLD (3) has had three runs from a spell and is going much better than it looks on paper. Tricky gate but well placed here and should be winding up late. I'M CRAFTY (2) turned in a huge run off a wide gate last time. Has a poor draw again but with a repeat will be storming into the finish. GOLD VANCOUVER (8) was fair fresh then not far away at Northam last time, finishing just behind YAMASHITA'S GOLD. Ready to win and gets chance. GIRLS ON FIRE (4) is resuming off a long break. Unplaced in three runs last time in but all three in tougher races including the Listed Perth Magic Millions last time. Watch closely this class fresh. LOOKS (10) has a much better draw this time and can give a sight at odds.
